changelog:
v3.3.5 — VOD Playback Fix for MediaTek Devices

• Fixed black screen on MTK devices — smart codec selector deprioritizes buggy OMX.MTK decoders
• Fixed watchdog recovery getting stuck in loop (single-frame renders no longer reset the ladder)
• Low-memory devices skip 1080p software decode and go straight to 720p
• Image cache cleared before playback to free memory for video decoders
• Safe player release prevents crash on stuck decoders
• Fixed missing error handlers after software decoder rebuild
